title: McCord's letter to Judge Sirica

tellings.quote: mcord M mcord out of our office is the one that gets pissed off over the fact that he thinks they're all getting sold down the stream here

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in 1973 James McCord, one of the men caught in the Watergate break-in, grew angry that he and the others were "getting sold down the stream" and wrote a letter to Judge John Sirica, who was hearing the case. Sheehan tells Michels that McCord came "out of our office," placing himself close to the turn that helped crack the Watergate cover-up open.
